about: A free, open source CRM for managing customers, leads and sales, built with Laravel.

prs.title: Importing contacts works when a row has no phone
prs.broken: Importing a list of people failed with an error if any row had no phone number, and nothing in that batch was imported.
prs.changed: The importer only uses the phone number when one is there.
prs.matters: Teams can import contact lists where some people have only an e-mail, as the CRM allows everywhere else.
